title: Design: Edit Customer list keeps the current pick in its A to Z place
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer A (it pays for others) and customer B, with customer A saved as customer B's Bill Invoices To in Edit Customer.
  • Start on customer B's page.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p1-08-after-open.png, bt-p1-09-after-searching.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click the edit icon on customer B's card.
  2. Click the Bill Invoices To field.
  3. Type part of a customer name (for example Vald).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Customer opens.

Step 2:

  • The list opens with "[customer B's name] (this customer)" as the first row.
  • The other customers follow A to Z, and customer A is highlighted (blue text, light blue background) in its own A to Z place, not moved to the top.

Step 3:

  • The "(this customer)" row stays first and the matching customers follow A to Z.

Words in square brackets stand for the value they name, such as customer A's name exactly as it is saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page), story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S1-R5: “The field's first option is "[customer] (this customer)"; picking it and saving clears the default.”
  • S3-R3: “Typing searches every customer in the organization except Counter Sale, A to Z, showing the first 50 matches; the first option is always "[customer] (this customer)".”
